When every route is fetched, then each has one h1, Home h1 is exactly "Marketing For Independent Optical Practices", no h1 over 8 words, every h2 is 10 words or fewer and in Title Case (404 heading included).
When src is scanned, then zero U+2014 and U+2013, no not-X-but-Y or banned words, no San Diego or Google Business Profile outside src/app/terms/page.tsx, CTAs in Title Case.

When searched for the say-so phrases (I will say so, where I would start, I am not the right, right person, If I cannot help), hits are only in home.ts, faq.ts, optical.ts (FAQ answer), booking.ts, contact.ts, app/book/page.tsx (meta description; added 2026-11-26) and insights/[slug]/page.tsx (hidden drafts, out of scope).
